A milestone feature release — branding, sharing, previews and a new look, all in
one. **Fully backward-compatible: no migration needed.** The major bump marks the
milestone; existing shares, links and volumes keep working unchanged.

## Added

- **Custom branding for self-hosters** — set `APP_NAME` (wordmark + tab title),
  `APP_LOGO` (a logo image URL that replaces the feather), and `ACCENT_COLOR`
  (hex, drives buttons/ring/accents). Each falls back to the featherdrop default
  when unset.
- **Download limit / burn-after-download** — cap how many times a share can be
  downloaded; the file is deleted the moment the limit is reached (counted
  atomically, so it can never be exceeded or burned by a bogus request).
- **Inline image/PDF preview** on the download page — shown only for unlimited,
  password-less shares, so it never bypasses a download limit, and never counts
  as a download.
- **Save the QR code as a PNG** — download the share QR as a crisp image for
  printing or pasting into a chat.
- **Link previews (Open Graph / Twitter cards)** — a shared link now shows a
  branded preview card. It is deliberately generic and never leaks the file's
  name.

## Changed

- **New logo** — a gold medallion with the feather carved out as negative space;
  the favicon, README banner and Unraid template icon match it. A self-hoster's
  `APP_LOGO` still overrides it.
- **Living background** — the ambient gold/violet aurora now drifts slowly, and
  holds still for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
- **Localization** — the download-limit and "Save QR code" strings now read
  correctly in all 26 languages (no more English fallbacks for non-English
  plurals).

## Security

- **Inline preview hardened** — previews are restricted server-side to inert
  types (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/PDF) and served with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`,
  so an uploaded HTML/SVG file can never run script on the app's origin;
  everything else downloads as an attachment.
